entities.summary: São Tomé and Príncipe is a sovereign nation in Central Africa, Africa. Its capital is São Tomé. Official languages include Portuguese. Government: Unitary semi-presidential republic. Population: approximately 0.2 million. Area: 964 km². Comprehensive index for São Tomé and Príncipe covering uninhabited discovery, Portuguese sugar plantations, slave trade, cocoa 'islands of chocolate', roça plantation system, forros and angolares communities, independence 1975, democratic transition, and contemporary challenges.
